protocol.scope: Twelve chronological isolated viewer-offer cases on one old development seed; ordinary practice only. No ranking or final.
protocol.hypothesis: A direct offer can bypass waiting for an expected public raise. A nearby eligible driver who viewed the gig within2minutes is a more informed target than profile-only selection. This remains uncertain because a view does not establish availability or sufficient fee.
protocol.selection: At most once per10min,08:00-18:00, take the most recent qualifying view in the unchanged base advance. Distinct order,view age<=2min,open public single-car gig,waiting order,lastPickupAt>=now+300,pickup ready<=now+180. Driver home within35road km,eligible audience,no booked/working gig known,under3successful base offers that day. No active base offers on target gig.
protocol.measurement: Compare target-gig views, bookings and fees at10and30min. Retain every offer answer. Public schedule unchanged in all arms. Offer only to the observed viewer at either current shown fee or90% of it.
protocol.decision: Proceed to a separately frozen policy experiment only if at least3discount offers are accepted or the same-fee offer creates at least3net additional booked cases by30min versus holding. Otherwise drop this targeting version. Do not expand sample after outcomes. Mechanism success alone never promotes a policy.
protocol.failureRule: Refuse launch while any other play is unfinished. Stop on uncertain mutations, missing acknowledgements or refused fork actions; retain every case. Delete all known temporary forks before another case. Base remains paused if error.
protocol.baseCheck: Unchanged archived16dpolicy continues through full week; its events and score must reproduce archived control exactly.
limitations: One selected old stream and12cases, not independent profit evidence.
Offers may change random draws or later competition; acceptance is observable, exact internal cause is not.
The base decision clock is unchanged; very short-lived views between base advances can be missed.
Forks receive no other dispatch actions for30min, identically in all arms.
A view does not prove the driver works today or can economically do the gig.
